The structure of Dy24Ga6 (reduced formula Dy4Ga) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/dm (No. 143), with 30 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Dy centers with 16 geometric neighbors (8 Dy, 8 Ga) and Ga centers with 12 Dy neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Dy-centered 16-vertex polyhedra, corner and edge sharing between Ga- and Dy-centered polyhedra, and edge sharing between Ga-centered 12-vertex polyhedra.
